item.title: Rogue agents, told by the labs
item.description: Company disclosures of agents misusing public and government sites, a taxonomy of rogue-agent activity, a distillation paper on incriminating misaligned models, and Epoch's InnovationEval. Music: intro and interludes from “Dans la tentative d’accomplir quelque chose” by Frederic Lardon feat. Laura Palmée (CC0). Outro: “Crap Transition” by Jesse Spillane, https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Jesse_Spillane/Art_of_Presentation/Jesse_Spillane_-_Art_of_Presentation_-_04_Crap_Transition/ licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); trimmed, faded and mixed with narration.
